Market today: The economy is showing surprising strength, which is usually good, but it also means inflation might stick around. This is the main driver for your tech/chip-heavy book, especially with margin amplifying moves.

Your holdings: SMCI (-19.44%), METU (-17.69%), MUU (-24.85%), SOXL (-55.22%), and SPAL (-40.72%) are all marked SELL and are deep in the red. These leveraged ETFs and chip names are feeling the pinch.

Watch: Keep an eye on QCOM. It has a strong scanner setup and could be a potential new idea if the market cooperates.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your current losing positions, especially the leveraged ones.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL further if they show weakness. These leveraged ETFs are bleeding and amplify your margin risk.
Consider trimming METU and MUU. Leveraged ETFs decay and are deep in the red.
Watch QCOM for a potential entry around 180.07 if it pulls back to that level, with a stop at 179.02.
